theme_strategy.description: Calm agri-tech aesthetic using organic sage/emerald greens, rich earth ochres, stone slate, and warm bone surfaces. Supports smooth dark/light mode switching.

permanent_safety_banner.text: CRITICAL FOOD SAFETY NOTICE: This tool provides predictive screening models based on NIR spectroscopy and synthetic algorithms. It does NOT certify food safety or compliance. Full lab assays & human expert verification are mandatory before human-food consumption.
permanent_safety_banner.style: bg-amber-500/10 border-l-4 border-amber-500 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-xs sm:text-sm p-3 rounded-r-md flex items-center gap-3 shadow-sm font-medium

modules.name: Dashboard
modules.description: High-density summary overview with stats cards (Total Samples Analysed, Avg Protein Content %, Safety Pass Rate, Retest Queue), recent samples table, quick filter tabs, and prominent 'New Analysis CTA'.

modules.name: New Analysis 4-Step Wizard
modules.description: Interactive step-by-step submission with progress stepper: Step 1: By-Product Selection & Metadata -> Step 2: NIR Spectrum Data Input (File upload/Synthetic Generator) -> Step 3: Processing & AI Feature Extraction -> Step 4: Summary & Run Analysis.
modules.layout: Step Wizard with smooth transition cards and loading skeletons

modules.name: Composition Analyser
modules.description: Interactive NIR Spectrum plot (900-1700nm wavelength vs absorbance) using Plotly, predicted values table with error estimates (e.g., Protein 48.2% ± 0.6%), and clear badges distinguishing AI Prediction vs Lab Measured.
charts: Plotly NIR Spectrum Chart with peak annotations and interactive range slider

modules.name: Anti-Nutritional Factors (ANFs)
modules.description: Detailed breakdown of Phytate, Tannins, Trypsin Inhibitor, Lectins, and Saponins with safety threshold gauges, risk level indicators, and mandatory 'Lab assay recommended' contextual note cards.
modules.layout: Grid of parameter cards with radial gauge meters and threshold reference lines

modules.name: Food-Safety Screening
modules.description: Rule-engine safety check for Aflatoxin, Microbial counts, Heavy metal/pathogens, and Allergens. Displays status badges (PASS, REVIEW, RETEST, FAIL) with rule rationale, tolerance limits, and the permanent safety notice banner.

modules.name: Final Sample Report & PDF Export
modules.description: Comprehensive printable sample report featuring overall Suitability Score (0-100), spider/radar radar summary, breakdown of protein quality, safety decision, and instant PDF download export function.

modules.name: Comparison View
modules.description: Side-by-side radar chart and metric comparison matrix for 5 key protein by-products (Guar Meal, Groundnut Cake, Almond Cake, Rice Bran, Pulse Residues) ranking suitability for human food formulations.

modules.name: Model Performance Page
modules.description: ML Evaluation view featuring predicted vs measured scatter plots, error metrics tables (RMSE, R², MAE), model version comparison charts, dataset CSV uploader, and an interactive 'Retrain Model' trigger with live progress bar simulation.

modules.name: Analysis Agent Chat + Activity Timeline
modules.description: Collapsible AI chat assistant with live 'Agent Activity' execution timeline (simulating tool calls: fetch_nir_spectrum, calculate_anf_ratio, check_aflatoxin_rule, compile_report), badge 'AI-generated, verify before use', and 'Human review required' action.

modules.name: Roadmap & Terminology Tooltips
modules.description: Feature roadmap timeline and hoverable tooltips across all technical terms (NIR, Phytate, Trypsin Inhibitors, Aflatoxin B1, NIRS 1700nm).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, filter tabs, modal triggers, chat inputs, download buttons, theme toggle, and status badges MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='new-analysis-btn', data-testid='sample-status-badge')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text has 4.5:1 contrast against background cards; hover states explicitly define text-color.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full focus-ring support on tabs, buttons, inputs using ring-2 ring-emerald-600 ring-offset-2.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always label synthetic data with DEMO DATA tag across UI cards and tables.
Ensure permanent food safety disclaimer banner is anchored or prominently present on analysis views.
Provide dark/light theme toggle in header bar.
Use Plotly for NIR Spectrum chart (900-1700nm) and model evaluation scatter plots.
Include live tool execution timeline inside the AI Chat agent panel.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
